title: Little George's wake and funeral crowds
summary: Charlotte describes the huge wake for little George, musicians white and black filling the house after the Steamer President job, since he had played many funerals.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: Well. With George playing, little George, my brother. We were talking while you were talking. We were talking about the occasion of his wake. How the people walked. The wake was. The line was just about two blocks long. And you had to go. You just had. It's a continual session. And the boat of Steamer President was docked before the Canal Street at that time. And when all the musicians knocked off that night from the Steamer President and they all came in. But it was just a floor of musicians. And all night long. All night long. And two and three across with. That was something. All the way from Rocheblaive and Conibe back to Broad Street. Couldn't hardly get in there. And that was the way, you know.
